speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Mallet Finger (Extensor Lag of the DIP Joint)

The history of the finger being forcibly extended by a pulling force, combined with your current inability to flex the distal joint and the resting extension, is classic for a mallet finger. The X-ray ruled out a fracture, suggesting this is likely a closed extensor tendon avulsion from the base of the distal phalanx. I recommend requesting images of the soft tissue to confirm the tendon disruption before finalizing treatment.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
